scenes.name: Intro
scenes.description: ancient stone amphitheater viewed straight on. Six broad seating tiers rise toward a seventh rear wall, with a tall rectangular stone panel centered above them. Night beneath a full moon and star-filled sky. Ancient weathered limestone, soft desert sand, low drifting smoke and thin fog, traces of an ancient ruined landscape. Dark, mysterious, monumental atmosphere. Preserve the amphitheater geometry and frontal composition. No people, modern objects or text.

scenes.name: Susta
scenes.description: Amphitheater steps/tiers, 6 big tiers from down to top, 7th tier is wall. static stone structure. above the steps are sky. vertical stone panel at the top center. ancient cyprus style. Night desert sand gradually gives way to greenery and flourishing trees. scenes.name: Balance
scenes.description: Amphitheater steps/tiers, 6 big tiers from down to top, 7th tier is wall. static stone structure. above the steps are sky. vertical stone frame at the top - center of the tier. ancient cyprus style. Water element is introduced, aquarius flowing calmly; trees and crops sway with the wind, springtime atmosphere at night. Highly detailed scene with extensive water features including elaborate water canals flowing through the amphitheater tiers. Multiple streams cascade down the stone steps, irrigating the greenery surrounding the structure. Abundant trees on both left and right sides of the tiers, their leaves rustling in the breeze. Water elements appear beneath the tiers, creating reflective surfaces. Rich vegetation blankets the stone surfaces, moss and creeping plants softening the ancient architecture. The water flows both above and below ground, creating a harmonious balance between stone and water in this Cypro-Phoenician Bronze Age ruin style landscape.
